title: Fix Admin Dashboard Backend Connection Timeout

requirements.summary: Fix the Admin Dashboard access failure caused by backend connection timeout by coordinating the useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout hook with actor initialization to eliminate race conditions between Internet Identity login and admin status check
acceptanceCriteria: After logging in via Internet Identity, the Admin Dashboard loads successfully without showing the timeout error message.
The admin status check (`isCallerAdmin`) is only initiated after the authenticated actor instance is confirmed ready.
If the backend call genuinely takes longer than expected, a retry mechanism attempts the request at least once before showing an error.
The timeout error screen ('Die Verbindung zum Backend hat zu lange gedauert') is not shown during normal authenticated admin login flow.

file_operations.description: Modify the hook to wait for both authenticated identity AND a non-fetching actor state before enabling the admin check query. Add a multi-phase loading state that distinguishes between waiting for actor, checking admin status, and timeout phases. Implement automatic retry logic that attempts the admin check at least once before showing timeout error. Ensure the hook only returns isLoading=false after the actor is confirmed ready and the initial admin check attempt completes or fails.

Update the AdminDashboard component to properly handle the new loading phases from useIsCallerAdminWithTimeout. Show a loading state while the actor is initializing and while the admin check is in progress. Only show the timeout error screen after all retry attempts have been exhausted. Ensure the component does not flash error messages during normal authentication flow by checking that both actor and identity are ready before rendering error states.

requirements.summary: Ensure the backend actor in useActor.ts always uses the authenticated Internet Identity principal when logged in, preventing admin-gated backend calls from failing due to anonymous identity fallback
acceptanceCriteria: When a user is authenticated via Internet Identity, all backend calls in the admin area use the authenticated actor, not the anonymous one.
The actor is re-created and queries are invalidated whenever the identity changes (login/logout).
No admin backend call is made with an anonymous principal.

file_operations.description: Add validation that checks both identity existence AND that the identity is not anonymous before enabling the admin check query. Use identity.getPrincipal().isAnonymous() to verify the user is authenticated. This prevents race conditions where the hook might attempt an admin check with a stale anonymous actor while the authenticated actor is still being created. Include this check in the enabled condition alongside actor readiness and isFetching state.
